candidate_evidence.quote: - [RADIATION] Simultaneous-integrated boost with IMRT: Simultaneous-integrated boost guided by FDOPA-PET

coder_notes: Radiotherapy-only trial (SIB IMRT guided by FDOPA-PET). FDOPA is an imaging tracer used for target delineation, not a registered intervention (R9), so not listed. Cns5 terminology: WHO grade IV, no IDH statement; historical by 'WHO grade IV' wording is a judgement call.
